data.title: 德尔塔 · 深夜篝火旁的烤肉分享
data.description: 夜色深邃的林间营地，温暖的篝火噼啪作响。德尔塔席地而坐，双手高高举起热气腾腾的大块烤肉递到面前，小脸沾着一点炭灰，笑得灿烂纯真。
data.location: wilderness campfire campsite surrounded by dark ancient pine trees
data.action: sitting cross-legged in fur bikini holding up a huge roasted meat on the bone, smiling proudly with smudge of soot on her cheek
data.lighting: warm dancing campfire flames bathing toned skin in golden radiance
data.mood: wholesome campfire warmth, adorable simple devotion, sweet feral camaraderie
data.promptProse: Sitting beside a campfire at night in fur bikini, wolf-girl Delta proudly offers a huge roasted meat bone with a wide grin.
data.animaCaption: Sitting by the crackling campfire, she proudly offers a large roast meat skewer with a radiant fanged smile.
